country.description: Fallback market when the delivery location cannot be resolved. Also sets the default city used for menu pricing context.
country.title: Country

location.description: Address, city, postcode, or 'latitude,longitude' used to resolve Uber Eats delivery results. Uber Eats gates restaurant availability by location, so results differ by area.
location.title: Delivery location

maxMenuItemsPerRestaurant.description: Cap on menu items returned for each restaurant. Pagination stops as soon as this cap is reached.
maxMenuItemsPerRestaurant.title: Max menu items per restaurant

maxRestaurants.description: Stop after this many unique restaurants across all search queries.
maxRestaurants.title: Max restaurants

mode.description: Search restaurants by keyword, scrape full menus from URLs/IDs, or search and pull the menu for every match.
enumTitles: Menus from restaurant URLs or IDs
mode.title: What to scrape

restaurantUrls.description: Uber Eats restaurant page URLs or store IDs (for example https://www.ubereats.com/store/name/AbCdEf123 or a full UUID). Used by menus and searchWithMenus modes.
restaurantUrls.title: Restaurant URLs or IDs

searchQueries.description: Restaurant, cuisine, or dish keywords. Required for search and searchWithMenus modes. Each query is paginated automatically until maxRestaurants is reached.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

title: Uber Eats Restaurant Search & Menu Scraper
